Commentary.Commentary: Now then, 131 runs and Namibia will storm into the finals of the tournament. If Assad Wala's side wants to play that final against Netherlands, they will have to bowl and field out of their skins. Join us after the break to find out.

On his four run final over, Viljoen says that he tries to bowl cross seam deliveries to get variable bounce. Says that he bowls slower bouncers and cutters in the final overs too. Adds that the surface isn't too bad and they are happy with the total they have to chase.

The Namibian pacers were perfect from the word go. They did not offer freebies to the PNG batters. Viljoen and Smit combined to dismiss the in-form openers early on. Bernard Scholtz and Gerhard Erasmus were superb with their spin bowling too. Skipper Erasmus pulling off that one-handed stunner has to be one of the best moments of the innings. Christi Viljoen bowled a superb last over, giving away just 4 runs. He is down for an interview with H. D. Ackerman.

Earlier, after winning the toss and deciding to bat first, things did not turn the way the PNG skipper would've expected it. They were struck thrice inside the Powerplay. Charles Amini then combined with Sese Bau and added an important 50-run stand.
Sese Bau along with Vanua has made sure that Papua New Guinea have something to defend. The two have added 30 runs in the final four overs.
Beauty to end an awesome over. Yorker wide outside off, Bau looks to carve it towards backward point but misses. Just 4 off the last over and Papua New Guinea finish on 130 runs.
Shorter in length this time, Vanua pulls this one towards mid-wicket for one.
Full ball again on off, Bau lofts this one over mid on for a single.
Full ball on off, Bau gets down on one knee and looks to paddle it over the fine leg fielder but misses. It goes off the bottom edge back towards the bowler.
Short of a length ball on off, Vanua pulls this one towards backward square leg for one.
Full ball on off, Bau drives this one through mid off for one.
Full ball on off, Vanua pushes this one beautifully through the covers for one.
Length ball outside off, Vanua goes for the slash on the off side but misses.
Pitched around leg, Bau looks to flick this one but misses to get hit on the pads. The ball goes towards finer leg off the pads and the batters take a leg bye.
Length ball on off, Vanua pushes this one off the back foot towards extra cover for one.

Just over and a SIX! Another good length ball wide outside off, Vanua slaps it down the ground. He does not get the whole of it but Vanua has committed himself to the shot. The ball just about clears the man at long on and it goes for a maximum.
Wide! Way wide outside off, Vanua looks to get bat on ball but misses. Wided.
Full ball wide outside off, Vanua drags it down the ground towards long on for a couple.
Short ball on middle, Vanua pulls it towards deep square leg for a single. There is a slight fumble from the fielder but no run taken.
EDGY FOUR! Vanua and PNG won't mind. Good length ball around off, Vanua swings hard but the ball takes the outside edge and goes to the third man fence.
Full ball on middle, driven towards long for a single.

Short of a length ball on middle, Vanus goes for the pull but can't get the shot off the middle of the bat. The ball falls closer to the short third man fielder who could've tried to catch the ball. The bowler is not happy.
Short ball outside off, Vanua pulls but misses to get any bat on ball.
He starts with a full ball outside off, Bau drives it towards long off for a single.
Christi Viljoen to bowl the 18th over of the innings.
Short of length ball on middle, Bau goes across the leg side and works it towards short third man for a single.
Around off, Vanua slaps it over the bowler's head for a single. Another mistimed shot from the PNG batter.
Beaten! Good length ball outside off, Vanua drives but misses.
Short ball on middle, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full ball outside off, a couple as Bau drives it wide of mid off.
Norman Vanua is the next batsman in.
OUT! Doriga departs! Full ball outside off, Doriga looks to launch it over the long off fence but finds the fielder in the deep. There was no power in the shot there and Papua New Guinea struggling.
JJ Smit returns. 2-0-12-1, his figures so far.
Short ball on middle, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On middle, defended back to the bowler.
Around off, blocked.
Short ball around off, pushed towards short third man for a single.
SIX! WOW! From the middle of the bat. Stand and deliver. Full ball around off, Bau clears his front leg and deposits the ball over the long on fence.
Full ball outside off, pushed towards cover for a run.
Craig Williams to bowl now.
Outside off, glanced to short third man for a quick single. 10 runs from the over.
SIX! Massive. Full ball on the pads, Doriga skips down the track and slams it over long on fence.
The batsman dances down the track. The batsmen have run through for a single.

Quick single. Short ball around off, Doriga cuts it towards point and takes off for a run. The point fielder gets to the ball quickly and fires a throw towards the non-striker's end. However, Bau did well to get back in his crease.
Full around off, pushed to the right of the bowler.
Short around off, puhsed towards cover for a run.
On the pads, Doriga looks to work it on the leg side but misses to get hit on the pads.
On middle, nudged towards square leg.
Full ball on middle, flicked towards short mid-wicket.
Kiplin Doriga is the new man in for PNG.

OUT! Stumped! The skipper strikes! Full ball outside off, Amini is trying to make room by going across the left stump. He misses his slash at the ball and the wicket keeper does the rest. 50-run stand is broken.
Quicker one around off, guided towards short third man for a single.
Full toss outside off, Bau looks to launch it over long off but mistimes it. The ball goes towards long off fielder on multiple bounce. A quick couple taken.
Gerhard Erasmus is back into the attack.
On the pads, flicked for a single through mid-wicket.
Around off, pushed through mid on for a single.
EDGY FOUR! Flighted ball around off, Amini goes back to loft it over long off but gets a thick outside edge. Short third man fielder chases the ball but the ball wins the race to the fence.
FOUR! Innovative this from Amini. Full ball outside off, he gets in position and plays the reverse sweep to perfection.
On middle, eases for a single through mid off.
Starts with a full ball on middle, Bau goes for the sweep but gets it off the top edge. The ball lands safely wide of short fine leg. A couple of runs taken.
Zhivago Groenewald to bowl for the first time in this game.
Beaten! Quicker one outside off, Amini pokes at the ball but misses. The keeper behind too cannot gather the ball cleanly.
Two runs this time. On the pads, Amini flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Drop and run. Superb running between the wicket. Short around off, punched towards point fielder and a quick single taken.
On middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Full and outside off again with the round arm. Amini drives it through the covers for a single.
Full and around off, driven through cover-point for a couple.
Short of a length ball around middle, tucked towards mid on for a single.
Out comes the physio to have a look!

On the helmet! Nicely bowled! Another try to play the reverse sweep, this time from Amini. There is extra bounce, it hits the glove and then onto the helmet. The helmet is off and Amini looks in a little pain.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
A huge shout but not give! Out comes the reverse sweep but the ball ends up hitting the glove. The bowler appeals but not given.
Shorter and on middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
On middle, it is worked towards mid-wicket.
Around middle, worked towards square leg for a single this time. 56 runs and three wickets in the first half of this innings.
Loopy ball around off, tapped towards point with the soft hands and a single stolen.
Short outside off, Bau goes back and guides it between the point and gully fielder. The gully fielder gives the ball a chase and keeps it two.
Full and straight, Bau defends it back to the bowler.
Short and outside off, punched off the back foot towards deep point for a single.
On middle, tucked towards square leg for a single to bring 50 for PNG.
Around off, pushed towards long on for a single.
Shortish length, a single through mid-wicket as Bau pulls it.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Just short that one. Full ball on middle, Bau slog sweeps it towards deep square leg. The fielder there comes charging in to catch but the ball falls just short and goes to the fence.
Around off, Bau blocks it out.
Short and around off, Amini taps it to deep point for a single. Misfield from the keeper allows an overthrow there.
Full on off, eased for a run through mid off by Amini.
The batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Full around off this time, driven straight to the cover fielder.
Short and outside off, pushed straight cover.
Full ball on middle, flicked towards square leg for a single.
FOUR! Welcome to the bowling mr. Skipper. Full ball around off, Amini lofts this over the mid off region and into the fence.
Gerhard Erasmus is into the attack now.
Full on middle, driven to long on for a single.
Another ball on middle, flicked straight to the fielder at short mid-wicket.
Full ball on middle, tucked to short mid-wicket.
Outside off, worked through point for a single this time.
Around off, blocked towards point this time.
Starts with a ball on the pads, turned behind square for a single.
Ben Scholtz to bowl now.
Outside off on a shortish length, punched through point for a single.
Sese Bau is the new man in.
OUT! Caught! Wicket no. 3 inside the Powerplay. Short ball on middle, Siaka looks to pull but the ball goes straight down the throat of Davin at deep square leg.
Good length delivery on middle, tucked towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Fuller ball outside off, driven firmly but straight to mid off. A quick run taken.
Short ball on middle, pulled towards deep square leg for a couple. He took off the first run and hence completing the second was never a problem there.
Full on the pads. Amini flicks it fine down the leg side to take a run.
Ben Shikongo returns. 1-0-5-0 so far for him.
Shortish length outside off, tapped towards covers for a single by Amini this time.
Outside off on a fuller length, pushed towards cover for a run.
Beaten again. Good length ball outside off, Siaka is rooted to his crease as he looks to drive but misses.
Full around off, pushed for a single towards cover.
Beaten! Superb delivery this one from Smit. Around off, angling into the left-hander. Amini again lunges to block but the ball goes through the gap between bat and pad, but just over the stumps.
Length ball around off, Amini comes forward to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads. That could've easily gone onto hit the stumps.
Charles Amini is the new man in.

OUT! Caught! Wicket number 2 and it is skipper Vala who departs for five. Length ball on middle, Assad looks to turn it towards mid-wicket but the ball takes the top edge and goes high in the air towards third man. Shikongo gets under the ball and gobbles it comfortably.
Outside off, Siaka taps it towards point and takes a run.
Short of a length ball on middle, Siaka pulls it behind square leg and gets a couple.
Around off, Siaka defends it out.
Around off, Siaka pushes it towards mid-wicket.
Shortish length ball on off, Vala punches it to left of the bowler for a single.
Beaten! Good length ball around off, angles away as Siaka looks to push at it.
Short ball around off, tucked towards square leg for a single.
Lega Siaka is the next batsman in.

OUT! Caught! Catch of the tournament. What a blinder this is from the skipper, Gerhard Erasmus. An absolute one-handed blinder. Full ball on middle and leg, Ura looks to loft it over the mid on fielder but the timing is not right. The ball goes high towards mid on. Erasmus runs behind, he thinks he may not reach there so he throws his right hand and gets the ball to stick.
Another single. A six and a couple of singles on the next two balls. On middle, Assad works it towards the leg side with the soft hands and scampers for a run.
On middle, Ura taps it towards square leg and takes a run.
SIX! Hammered over the long off. A full ball around off, in the slot for Ura. He gets to the pitch of the ball and launches it over the long off region. Clean strike.
JJ Smit comes to bowl as the first change.
Around middle and leg, Vala looks to work it down the leg side but gets a leading edge. The ball drops onto the pitch.
WIDE! Down the leg side. Assad goes for the pull but misses.
Short ball on middle, Ura pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Outside off, punched straight to the fielder at point.
Good length ball on the hips, Vala tucks it towards deep mid-wicket and takes a single.
Around off this time, tapped towards the cover region and a single taken. There is a run out attempt by the cover fielder at the non-striker's end but he misses. Could've been tight.
Viljoen starts with a poor line down the leg side. Assad pulls but the short fine leg fielder dives and makes a half stop. A single taken but the fielder has saved 3 runs there.
Christi Viljoen to share the new ball from the other end.
On off, Ura keeps it out.
Play and a miss! Length ball outside off, Ura throws his bat at the ball but misses.
Full around off, lofted over the bowler for a couple. That did not come from the middle of the bat. Another couple.
Gets the line right this time as dishes this outside off on a good length. Ura pushes it to the point fielder.
WIDE! Sprays down the leg side, does Shikongo this time. Ura flicks but misses. Called wide by the umpire.
Short and outside off, Ura punches it over point and picks a couple to get off the mark.
Shikongo starts with a full ball around off, driven straight to the cover fielder.
The players are out in the middle. Tony Ura and Assad Vala, the two openers are out in the middle too. Ben Shikongo to start the proceedings first up for Namibia. Here we go...

PITCH REPORT - The pitch looks to be two-faced. Good length balls can bounce a bit here and there. The batters needs to show some composure while batting. 160 should be a challenging total on this surface.

Namibian skipper Gerhard Erasmus says that he wanted to bat first as well. Adds that last 3 days have been superb for them. Mentions that everyone in the side needs to stay focused and that's what they are trying to do.

The PNG skipper adds that batting first helps them as they have the chance of putting big total batting first. Adds that the side has got good support from home. Tells that the side wants to win the tournament and finish on the positive note.

Namibia (Playing XI) - Stephan Baard, Nikolaas Davin , JP Kotze, Craig Williams, Gerhard Erasmus (C), Zane Green (W), JJ Smit, Christi Viljoen, Zhivago Groenewald (IN FOR Jan Frylinck), Bernard Scholtz, Ben Shikongo
Papua New Guinea (Playing XI) - Tony Ura, Assad Vala (C), Lega Siaka, Charles Amini, Sese Bau, Riley Hekure, Kiplin Doriga (W), Norman Vanua, Jason Kila, Damien Ravu, Nosaina Pokana
TOSS - Papua New Guinea have won the toss and opt to bat first.

Time for the semi-final no. 2. It is Papua New Guinea who are taking on Namibia. Papua New Guinea qualified for the T20 World Cup in Australia by taking the top position after the group stage round, winning 5 off the 6 matches. Namibia, on the other hand, beat Oman in the 2nd Playoff to qualify for the finals and play this second semi-finals of the tournament. Stay with us for Toss update.
